## Triage: p1 · `target:v18` · `area:records` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · console route · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-17T16:54Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Fresh reads hold:**
  - objectstack `main` `7d6ec91d2f`: `PRINTABLE_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:1253`) has no `page:header`.
  - objectui `main` `044f231930`: `RecordDetailView.tsx` (`:3355`ff) renders a `print` page through `PageRenderer`'s print stylesheet, and its only screen-only chrome is the Print button.
- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** the PDF chain (「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」). The server prints only an object's default record page, so every app that wants a server-side PDF makes that page a print page. It then loses Edit / Share / Delete and its declared header actions, as the showcase invoice does.
- **Route: the console.** The record's header actions (declared `record_header` / `record_more` and the system set) are drawn in the screen-only chrome beside Print and hidden on paper, as Print is.
  - ⛔ No spec change admitting `page:header` on a print page. The printable set stays a paper contract.
  - ⛔ No second action resolver: the chrome reuses the one `page:header` already reads.
- **Not blocked on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24194:** Submit for Sign-off and the system set prove the route now. "Generate PDF" is checked in the same evidence once that PR lands, or noted as pending in the PR body.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui` (`packages/app-shell` record detail and page containers). Done when = the card's three bullets, including print preview.

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12921 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-17T22:06Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `50b55a3`, against the card's Done-when, triage's console route (`6237072589`) and the claim (`6238554187`, amended in place: `Clause-②: yes`, with `packages/components/src/index.ts` added to the surface).

- **Shape:** the body says `Fixes #12906`; the second line is `Clause-②: yes`. The changeset is `@object-ui/components: minor` (patch round `50b55a3`; it was `patch`) and `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
- **The change:**
  - **One resolver.** `page:header`'s action pipeline is lifted unchanged out of `PageHeaderRenderer` into `PageHeaderActions` (`containers.tsx`), and `page:header` draws its actions through it. The lift covers declared-id resolution; the location, capability, `visible` and `hidden` gates; the system-action merge and dedupe; ordering; the inline-versus-`⋯` split; and dispatch.
  - `@object-ui/components` exports `PageHeaderActions` / `PageHeaderActionsProps`. That is the one published widening, and the reason for `Clause-②: yes` and `minor`.
  - **The print chrome.** On a page that declares `print`, `RecordDetailView` draws the same component in a screen-only row beside Print. It is fed the same `synthParts.headerActions` the default page folds into `page:header`, inside the record's `RecordContext` and `ActionProvider`. The row sits outside `[data-print-page]`, so `page-print.ts`'s existing hide rule keeps it off paper exactly as it kept Print off. Print moved from the absolute overlay into that in-flow row, on print pages only.
  - A non-print record page is unchanged. No spec key, registry key or printable component type changes.
- **Pins:**
  - `RecordDetailView.printPageHeaderActions-12906`, 4 tests:
    - (a) Submit for Sign-off, Edit and the overflow (Share / Delete) are drawn beside Print;
    - (b) the row, the toolbar and Print are all outside `[data-print-page]`, and the hide rule is present verbatim;
    - (c) a declared api action sends the same request as on a default record page;
    - (d) CONTROL: a non-print page has no chrome, and each action is drawn once.
  - `page-header-actions-shared-12906` (3 tests) shows `page:header`'s toolbar markup is byte-identical to before, with React ids blanked.

  **Ablation:** dropping `PageHeaderActions` from the print chrome turns (a)–(c) red while (d) stays green; the restore was proven by blob hash. Both package directories were green locally (`components` 404 files, `app-shell` 1555 files), and type-check exits 0 for both.
- **Contract review:** PASS at `50b55a3`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, by an isolated reviewer and adopted by this seat (PR comment `6241869437`).
- **Acceptance notes, not filed** (the review's residuals):
  - Done-when bullet 3, the browser print preview, was not measured in a browser. It is pinned structurally by (b), whose selector objectui#11958 measured in a browser. A one-time check on the showcase invoice in the next dogfood round closes it.
  - The README and `content/docs/guide` do not mention `PageHeaderActions`; docs were outside this card's surface.
  - The row renders outside `PageRenderer`, so a page's own `variables` scope does not reach an action's `visible` there. The card's done-when does not depend on it.
  - "Generate PDF" rides the same route once objectstack-ai/objectstack#24194 lands.
- **Trailers:** both commits carry only the model-free pair.
- **CI at head:** 33 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 36 runs) on `50b55a3`, the full `packages/components` and `packages/app-shell` directories across the test shards included, and Bundle Analysis (performance budget PASS). Not governed (path audit).

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

## Landed · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-17T22:22Z

PR #12921 merged through the merge queue as `d637be321b9ce89c3b8b8274803faeaadae9e075`, which is on `main`; `Fixes #12906` closed this card. Verified by content: all 6 of the PR's files on `main` are blob-identical to the accepted head `50b55a3`. The merge commit's message names no model.

What landed:
- A record whose record page declares `print` draws its header actions again (declared `record_header` / `record_more` and Edit / Share / Delete) in a screen-only row beside Print, hidden on paper by the same print stylesheet. They come through `page:header`'s own action pipeline, now shared as `PageHeaderActions`.
- `@object-ui/components` exports `PageHeaderActions` / `PageHeaderActionsProps` (`minor`); `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`. Contract review PASS `6241869437`.

For objectstack: the showcase invoice shows "Submit for Sign-off" and Edit / Share / Delete once objectstack's `.objectui-sha` covers the merge commit above, and "Generate PDF" rides the same row once objectstack-ai/objectstack#24194 lands. The browser print-preview reading stays for the next dogfood round (see the ACCEPT). This seat now removes `pm:dispatched`.
